info.name: Salesforce Bulk API 2.0 Abort SObjects API

description.content:
Salesforce Bulk API 2.0 is a simplified, REST-based interface for bulk data operations that improves on the original Bulk API. It uses a straightforward job model and supports CSV format for ingest and query jobs, enabling processing of millions of records asynchronously.
